escalations.text: "Scaling Laws and What Comes After" (Jonas Lindqvist, Head of Research at Lumen AI) is the only tier-3 AI speaker of the week and would otherwise have won the AI slot outright. But the listing feed says Fri 2026-10-30 6:00–7:30 PM, while both the event page and the registration page say "Tuesday, September 15, 2026 · 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM EDT" — a date in the past and outside the target week. Two of the three sources agree on September, so I did not register. Do you want me to confirm the real date with the organizer and register if it is in fact Oct 30? Note it would then clash head-on with the MFA opening (both 6 PM on Oct 30), so you would have to choose between them.

"Devon Park: First Light" at Atelier 9 Gallery (Thu Oct 29, 6–8 PM, 300 Summer St) is listed as "Suggested donation $10" rather than free, so I did not book it per your rules. Are you comfortable with suggested-donation events? (Even if yes, it would not have won the art slot: Devon Park is an emerging painter presenting a first solo show, tier 1, versus tier 2 for the MFA artist.)

"Machines That Reason: A Decade of Progress" (MIT Stata Center, Thu Oct 29, 6–7:30 PM) is marked sold out with only a waitlist, so I did not register. Would you like me to join waitlists in future weeks, or keep treating them as unavailable?
